longrope_fix.reason: vLLM 0.11.0 selects the LongRoPE factors for the whole forward call when any position exceeds 4096. Using long factors for every position prevents a sequence's KV cache from mixing encodings as the batch changes.

sampling.source: vLLM defaults. This Phi revision's generation_config.json sets no sampling values.

provenance.revision: Registered Hugging Face main revision as of 2026-11-18. The Modal app does not pass --revision. The public serving check verifies both names and the vLLM version and records the revision only if the endpoint exposes it.
